rfam.comment: SAM-I-IV variant riboswitch is part of the clan CL00012 (SAM-I, SAM-IV and SAM-I-IV) which share a common SAM binding core. It is found upstream of a number of genes which code for proteins involved in methionine or cysteine biosynthesis. It has been found mostly in the order Actinomycetales [1]. PDB 4L81 and 4OQU has been reported for SAM-I-IV aptamer, which shows the SAM binding core and an alternative PK-2 subdomain shared with SAM-IV [3].
